screening_decisions.reason: Modeling study of required sensitivity; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study comparing a POC test to NAAT with 2x2 data.
Methodological/meta-epidemiological study unrelated to POC CT diagnostic accuracy in the target population.
Prospective study in clinic with POC tests (e.g., OIA) and laboratory tests (PCR); likely reports diagnostic performance or sufficient data for accuracy; uncertain details but plausible fit.
Pilot diagnostic accuracy evaluating a rapid POC test (QuickVue) against PCR (NAAT) with sensitivity/specificity reported.
Guideline on syndromic management; not a diagnostic accuracy study of POC CT tests versus NAAT.
Narrative/position review on STI rapid tests; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study meeting the protocol.
Prospective diagnostic accuracy comparing POC antigen tests (CRT, ACON) against NAAT in men and women; sensitivity/specificity reported.
Prospective clinic-based evaluation of rapid POC test versus NAAT (Roche Amplicor) with performance metrics reported.
Prospective diagnostic accuracy of a rapid POC urine test in men versus PCR (NAAT), with sensitivity/specificity reported.
Guidance on laboratory-based detection; not a primary POC diagnostic accuracy comparison with NAAT in eligible populations.
Systematic review, not a primary diagnostic accuracy study with participant-level testing and 2x2 data.
Guideline evidence summary; not a primary POC diagnostic accuracy study versus NAAT.
Decision/cost-effectiveness modeling; no direct prospective diagnostic accuracy with 2x2 data.
Prospective evaluation in clinic attendees of a rapid home-use CT test versus NAAT with accuracy metrics; fits POC rapid test accuracy against NAAT.
Treatment of chancroid (H. ducreyi); not CT diagnostic accuracy nor POC testing.
Methodological tool paper; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study on CT POC tests.
Statistical methodology; not a primary POC CT diagnostic accuracy study.
Overview of systematic reviews; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study with participant testing.
Modeling of partner notification impacts; not a diagnostic accuracy study of POC testing.
Diagnostic accuracy evaluation of rapid POC tests (Clearview MF, CRT) against PCR (NAAT) with sensitivity/specificity; clinic-based populations.
Methodological assessment of publication bias; not a primary CT POC diagnostic accuracy study.
Review of RCTs on screening/treatment outcomes; not a POC diagnostic accuracy comparison with NAAT.
Observational risk factor study; not a diagnostic accuracy evaluation of POC CT tests.
Methodological/policy focus; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study of POC CT tests.
Narrative review of laboratory methods; not a primary rapid POC diagnostic accuracy study versus NAAT.
Secondary research (systematic review); not a primary diagnostic accuracy study reporting per-participant 2x2 data against a NAAT reference.
Systematic review of NAATs on urine (non-POC) and secondary research; does not present primary POC DTA against NAAT with 2x2 data.

Primary diagnostic accuracy evaluation of a rapid POC optical immunoassay in reproductive-age women; multiple tests including PCR were performed on all specimens. Although a composite reference standard was used for ‘true infection’ in the abstract, NAAT (PCR) was applied to all, so NAAT-based 2x2 data may be extractable at full text.
Population prevalence survey; does not evaluate a rapid POC test’s diagnostic accuracy versus NAAT with 2x2 data.
Cross-sectional DTA of rapid POC tests for Chlamydia (ACON and QuickVue) in symptomatic women, compared against NAAT reference; reports sensitivity/specificity indicative of 2x2 data.
Diagnostic accuracy comparison including a rapid POC EIA (Clearview) against NAATs in women; suitable DTA design with performance metrics that imply 2x2 data.
Primary DTA of a rapid POC assay (BioStar OIA) in adolescent females with two NAATs as reference; reports sensitivity/specificity.
Primary DTA of a rapid POC Chlamydia test in asymptomatic men using BD ProbeTec PCR (NAAT) as reference; provides sensitivity/specificity.
Prevalence study using NAAT only; no rapid POC index test evaluated against NAAT with 2x2 data.
Narrative/overview article; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study of a POC test versus NAAT.
Surveillance/epidemiology; does not assess rapid POC test diagnostic accuracy versus NAAT.
Cross-sectional aetiology/risk factor study with PCR; not a DTA of rapid POC test versus NAAT.
Primary DTA of a rapid POC Chlamydia test compared to PCR (NAAT) in a clinical setting; reports sensitivity/specificity.
Review of diagnostic options; not a primary DTA of POC test versus NAAT.
Performance evaluation of a rapid POC Chlamydia test versus PCR/SDA in women; provides diagnostic accuracy metrics consistent with 2x2 data.
Genotypic/serovar association study; not a diagnostic accuracy evaluation of a rapid POC test versus NAAT.
Non-manufacturer-sponsored DTA of a rapid POC test versus NAAT (Aptima) in women; reports sensitivity/specificity and factors (bacterial load) affecting performance.
Narrative review of immunopathogenesis; not a DTA study of a POC test.
Methodological paper on search filters; not a primary study of rapid POC test accuracy versus NAAT.
Primary DTA of a rapid optical immunoassay (POC) versus LCR (NAAT) on endocervical samples; reports sensitivity/specificity.
Diagnostic performance evaluation of three rapid POC tests versus NAAT in women; provides sensitivity and specificity; aligns with the review objective.
Risk factor review; no primary DTA of rapid POC test versus NAAT.
Guideline document; not a primary diagnostic accuracy study.
Prototype rapid POC device evaluated against NAAT with iterative improvements; small feasibility study but reports sensitivity/specificity; include for further assessment of 2x2 availability.
Retrospective follow-up/treatment outcomes study; not a DTA of a rapid POC test versus NAAT.
